say:3:1526002002:1.text: Save that energy for the fallen god. Corpses aren't really your field of study.
say:3:1526002002:1.source_cn: 留着那个精力去对付丰饶神吧。你不是应对死亡的专家。
say:3:1526002002:1.male: Save that energy for the fallen god. Corpses aren't really your field of study.
say:3:1526002002:1.female: Save that energy for the fallen god. Corpses aren't really your field of study.

say:4:1526002005:1.text: I'm thinking. These villagers from Tuttleton... their bodies have been lying here longer than they should.
say:4:1526002005:1.source_cn: 我在想对策。图塔镇居民的尸体堆在这里有一段时日了。
say:4:1526002005:1.male: I'm thinking. These villagers from Tuttleton... their bodies have been lying here longer than they should.
say:4:1526002005:1.female: I'm thinking. These villagers from Tuttleton... their bodies have been lying here longer than they should.

say:5:1526002006:1.text: And for once, I'll thank that petty skeleton god. His darkness sealed the town off and kept the rot from spreading to the outside.
say:5:1526002006:1.source_cn: 唯独这一点，我会感谢那个小心眼的骷髅老头。如果不是他用...
say:5:1526002006:1.male: And for once, I'll thank that petty skeleton god. His darkness sealed the town off and kept the rot from spreading to the outside.
say:5:1526002006:1.female: And for once, I'll thank that petty skeleton god. His darkness sealed the town off and kept the rot from spreading to the outside.

say:6:1526002007:1.source_cn: 不过等他陨落后，诅咒的黑暗就会消散，到时必须尽快处理这...

say:9:1526002009:1.text: If I leave them as they are, the plague will spread. Halia will get hit first, and the Wildborn right after.
say:9:1526002009:1.source_cn: 放着不管会有很大的麻烦。瘟疫扩散，离这最近的呼临城会第...
say:9:1526002009:1.male: If I leave them as they are, the plague will spread. Halia will get hit first, and the Wildborn right after.
say:9:1526002009:1.female: If I leave them as they are, the plague will spread. Halia will get hit first, and the Wildborn right after.

say:10:1526002010:1.text: People will die long before any crops have a chance to ripen.
say:10:1526002010:1.source_cn: 等不到麦穗成熟，人就已经死绝了。
say:10:1526002010:1.male: People will die long before any crops have a chance to ripen.
say:10:1526002010:1.female: People will die long before any crops have a chance to ripen.

say:11:1526002011:1.text: Luckily, we don't have Halia's uptight scholars or the Wildborn's stubborn warriors here to argue about tradition.
say:11:1526002011:1.source_cn: 幸好，这里既没有迂腐的呼临学者，也没有顽固的雅库伯尔人。

say:11:1526002011:1.female: Luckily, we don't have Halia's uptight scholars or the Wildborn's stubborn warriors here to argue about tradition.

say:12:1526002012:1.text: So for once, I can do the right thing—burn the bodies all at once!
say:12:1526002012:1.source_cn: 哈！我终于能用一把火，把尸体全烧了。
say:12:1526002012:1.male: So for once, I can do the right thing—burn the bodies all at once!
say:12:1526002012:1.female: So for once, I can do the right thing—burn the bodies all at once!
